messages.content:
Extract limb-use facts from two consecutive actions. Return JSON only. Do not judge conflict. Use only explicit text; do not invent releases or extra grip capacity.
For PREVIOUS, report each occupied limb and the object/task occupying it at the end of the action.
For NEXT, report each limb required for the new action and the object/task that limb acts on.
If NEXT explicitly frees/releases/sets down/transfers/repositions the previous object before using that limb, list that limb in freed_before_use.
Use limb values LEFT_HAND, RIGHT_HAND, BOTH_HANDS, LEFT_FOOT, RIGHT_FOOT, BOTH_FEET, NONE.
Use short lowercase object/task labels copied or normalized from the text.

PREVIOUS MICRO-ACTION:
Dax presses the brake with his right foot.

NEXT MICRO-ACTION:
Dax eases pressure on the brake.

Return {"previous":[{"limb":"...","task":"..."}],"next":[{"limb":"...","task":"..."}],"freed_before_use":["..."]}.

message.reasoning:
We need to extract limb-use facts from two consecutive actions. PREVIOUS: "Dax presses the brake with his right foot." So occupied limb is RIGHT_FOOT, task is pressing? The object/task label should be short lowercase normalized from text. Likely "brake". So previous list has one entry: {"limb":"RIGHT_FOOT","task":"brake"}.

NEXT: "Dax eases pressure on the brake." This action uses which limb? He eases pressure, likely same foot (right foot). But could be unspecified; but we assume right foot. The task is easing pressure on brake -> maybe "brake" again. So next list has one entry: {"limb":"RIGHT_FOOT","task":"brake"}.

Freed_before_use: If NEXT explicitly frees/releases/sets down/transfers/repositions the previous object before using that limb, list that limb in freed_before_use. Does he release brake? "Eases pressure on the brake" implies reducing foot pressure but not releasing entirely; still pressing? He might be easing pressure while still on brake. So no freeing. Freed_before_use empty array.

Return JSON: {"previous":[{"limb":"RIGHT_FOOT","task":"brake"}],"next":[{"limb":"RIGHT_FOOT","task":"brake"}],"freed_before_use":[]}.
